summary: Release-audit check, web preview at 390x844. Every requested item passed. (1) Women's Shield > Campus security > 'Ask DHARA' opens the Ask tab at /?draft=...&entry=... and fills the chat-input with exactly 'How do I contact campus security or file a complaint?'. (2) QA Outbound Guard: on /emergency, tapping call-112 shows a window.alert reading 'Simulated — nothing sent ... tel:112', the URL stays on /emergency, and the status text says the dialler was not opened. The same notice appears with no tel: navigation for Women's Shield hl-181 and Anti-Ragging 'Call'. The Silent alert SMS path (alert-contact-*) shows the notice with the full SMS body, and no sms: navigation happened. (3) Ask DHARA: 'how do I complain if my RTI is ignored' returns an answer that points to the Information Commission. Its citations (under 'View Legal Details') list RTI 18 first. (4) Backend: 4/4 pytest passed. /api/health returns outbound_mode=simulate. A PNG sent as audio/m4a returns 415. An empty file returns 400 'empty or too short'. A request without auth returns 401/403. No deprecated expo packages found (expo-av, expo-barcode-scanner, expo-background-fetch). No file outside src/outbound.ts calls Linking.openURL, sendSMSAsync or Share.share directly.

Labels for the same Act are inconsistent: 'RTI 18' and 'RTI 3' vs '§ 6' (RTI s.6 shown without the Act prefix).
RTI 18 shows 'May be outdated — last checked over 90 days ago' (verified_at 2026-06-01).
The modal has no testIDs; 'Continue in English' can only be found by its text. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/LanguageOnboardModal.tsx
